// Fixture for scripts/test-scripts.sh (poll-check): stored as .txt so the tree's
// Go tools never compile it. Both calls carry the marker, one on the line above.
package zzpollprobe

import (
	"testing"

	"github.com/ianglennon/tierplan/proto/testsupport"
)

func TestPollsForAnExternalCondition(t *testing.T) {
	done := false
	testsupport.WaitFor(t, "the engine to answer", func() bool { return done }) // testsupport: external, a real engine
	// testsupport: external, the child process writing its file
	testsupport.Poll(t, 0, "the file to exist", func() (bool, string) { return done, "" })
}
